CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Schism and Syncretism in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Schism and Syncretism in Israel.
   B. Say Schism and Syncretism in Israel has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Schism and Syncretism in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Schism and Syncretism in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)

   D. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
